'''Shuhei Sakaguchi''' (Japanese: '''阪口周平''' ''Sakaguchi Shūhei'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Sakaguchi was born on September 5, 1977, in {{wp|Osaka Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, most notably providing the voice of [[Ridley]]. He was formerly affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Mausu Promotion}}, and is now affiliated with Aksent.
